observed.statement: Canonical and released Codex runtime trees contain 17 byte-identical files and pass the named package validators.
The rebuilt release ZIP has one portable top-level skill directory, direct SKILL.md, 17 entries, zero backslash names, and byte parity with canonical runtime.

All ten natural qualification cases produced fresh pinned gpt-5.6-sol returns at package fingerprint 8833af96 and independently passed their hidden behavioral contracts. The separate current qwen35 prompted regression is 9 of 10, with one unsupported unchanged-state failure retained as negative smaller-model evidence.
observed.basis: verification/evidence/codex-natural-qualification.md, verification/testforge-review.md, and retained current qwen run

impact_map: SKILL.md governs admission, packet design, coordination, evidence merge, recovery, and closure.
Runtime references deepen topology, delegation, authority, recovery, and verification behavior.
Templates and validator create a deterministic declared-plan surface without claiming sequential byte-handoff proof.
Documentation translates the runtime contract into a customer journey while preserving evidence boundaries.

invariants.statement: The root retains mission, authority, merge, and final-answer custody.
No simultaneously active workers own the same declared mutable surface.
Worker reports remain agent-reported until root observation reconciles evidence.
Delegation does not enlarge user authority or tool admission.
Canonical runtime, released runtime, and release ZIP contain the same 17 runtime files.

risks.statement: The coordinator may over-orchestrate trivial direct work.
Parallel workers may collide on one mutable surface or sequence presentation before correctness.
Worker tool access or suggestions may be mistaken for user authority to publish or communicate.
Agent-reported completion may be laundered into root-verified truth.
Relative runtime paths, package drift, or non-portable ZIP entries may break delivery.
Customer documentation may overstate untested host behavior or drift from repaired runtime doctrine.
Future Codex collaboration-tool contracts may drift from the documented live schema.
Natural Codex behavior may fail even when prompted regression constraints pass.
An incomplete suite or aggregate score may hide an indispensable behavioral failure.
The skill may fail clean-host installation, discovery, implicit routing, or live invocation.
